steps.headline: The Floating / Taskbar buttons are now one 'Minimize to tray' switch.
steps.changed: Switch on: the buddy is an icon in your taskbar (menu bar on a Mac). Switch off: he floats on your desktop. It works exactly as before, just one switch instead of two buttons.
steps.notice: If the buddy is on, flipping the switch swaps the floater for the icon (or back) straight away.
steps.risk: With the buddy switched off, flipping it only remembers your choice; nothing appears until you turn the buddy on.
